experiments.offer: Standard catalogue pricing, no discount. Digital PDF $19, Classic softcover $39, Premium hardcover $64.

experiments.capacity_constraint: Proof-first fulfillment is operator-attended. Treat concurrent in-flight paid orders as the binding constraint and pause the row rather than the queue.
